Next to her on the center floor, a large terracotta vase stands tall and unglazed. A man in a yellow shirt stands on the right, pointing at the vase with his index finger while looking toward the woman. Behind them, a wooden shelf holds three small green bowls stacked neatly. A black cat sleeps on the shelf, curled into a tight ball beside the bowls. The woman looks at the man, acknowledging his gesture. There is no electric kiln visible in the background.
